data.text: God stands in the assembly of God; among the gods he gives judgment:
data.titulo: God Gives Judgment in the Assembly

data.text: “How long will you judge unjustly and show favor to the wicked? Selah.
Defend the weak and the fatherless; uphold the cause of the afflicted and poor.
Rescue the weak and needy; deliver them from the hand of the wicked.
They neither know nor understand; they walk about in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.
I said, ‘You are gods, all of you sons of the Most High.’
Yet you will die like mortals and fall like any ruler.”
Rise up, God, judge the earth, for all the nations are yours to inherit.
data.titulo: Rise Up, God, and Judge the Earth
